messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — the Python quickstart on docs seems to have drifted vs the 0.9 SDK. The snippet uses `RedwoodClient(api_key=...)` but after upgrading I hit: TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'api_key'. Also the sidebar link for async/streaming leads to a 404 (https://docs.redwood.ai/python/async). :eyes:

nina: Ugh, thanks for the report. Can you paste the exact snippet you copied + `pip freeze` output?

alex: Copied straight from the quickstart page: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])

async def main():
    resp = await client.generate('hey')
    print(resp.text)
```
Running it throws the TypeError immediately on client init.

rico: Yep, that matches the docs-drift we saw after the sync/async split last month. Current SDK uses explicit clients: `RedwoodClient` (sync) and `RedwoodAsyncClient` (async). Also the auth kwarg is `token=` not `api_key=`. Correct async example: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodAsyncClient
import os

client = RedwoodAsyncClient(token=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))

async def main():
    async with client:
        resp = await client.chat.create(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}])
        print(resp.output_text)
```
Notes: use `async with` to close transports, and the modern APIs are under `.chat`/`.completion` instead of `generate`.

alex: That fixes the init error, thanks. One more pain point: docs have almost no guidance on retry/backoff behavior. Our app hit 429 -> 500 intermittently and it failed hard. Is there an SDK retry policy we should rely on?

nina: Good catch. There is a builtin retry layer in the transport but it was underspecified in docs. I'll open a docs ticket to add a "Retry & Errors" section with defaults (5xx exponential backoff, jitter, 3 retries for 5xx, 2 for 429 by default) and code patterns for custom retry hooks.

rico: Filed internal ticket DEVEX-427 and linked PR for docs update (#1148). Also we'll add a short example showing how to attach a custom retry strategy: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, RetryPolicy
client = RedwoodClient(token=..., retry_policy=RetryPolicy(max_retries=5, backoff='exponential'))
```
We'll backport the example to the quickstart.

alex: Another follow-up: mypy/type checkers complain `RedwoodAsyncClient` methods return `Any` so I have to scatter `# type: ignore`. Any ETA on stubs or typed responses?

rico: We're working on typed responses and TypedDicts for the common payloads. Plan: ship a `redwood-sdk[types]` extra containing .pyi stubs and small TypedDicts in next week's patch. If you need them ASAP you can `pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk@types-preview#egg=redwood-sdk` for a preview. We'll also make async client generics so `chat.create` has a proper return type.

nina: Docs PR merged to fix the quickstart, add async/streaming anchors, and include the retry section. I've queued a deploy.

docs-bot: docs-site: PR #1148 merged by nina.

deploy-bot: docs-site: deploy queued (build 5421).

deploy-bot: docs-site: deploy succeeded — https://docs.redwood.ai/python-quickstart (updated) :tada:

alex: Verified updated page and confirmed the `token=`/`RedwoodAsyncClient` snippet works. Will try the types preview and report back if anything else pops up. Thanks! :raised_hands:
